dates.title: Shows are synced in
dates.description: Your shows come in automatically, so there is always something to schedule against.

slots.title: Slots set on every show
slots.description: How many artists each show needs, main and understudy.

flow.title: Booking flow
flow.description: Offers go out in tiers. Tier 1 is asked first, later tiers open only if a tier falls short.

people.title: Add your artists
people.description: Nobody to book until your roster has active artists. Import a sheet or add them by hand.

ladder.title: Rank your casts
ladder.description: Cast priorities decide who is offered first. A city with no tier 1 cast opens to nobody.

eligibility.title: Check who is eligible
eligibility.description: Which casts belong to which show, in which city.

timing.title: Confirm the offer timing
timing.description: When offers go out, and how long artists have to answer.

team.title: Invite your production team
team.description: The producers who plan dates, run offers and confirm bookings. Confirming can stay with you.

letterhead.title: Letterhead
letterhead.description: Your name, address and logo on every order.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: ShowFlow ships no default clauses. Yours to author.

countersign.title: Countersignature
countersign.description: Who signs on behalf of the org.

whereItGoes.title: Where it goes
whereItGoes.body: Get running leaves the sidebar. The rules it set stay readable in Settings under "How this org works", with who changed what and when.

whenItComesBack.title: When it comes back
